title: Date count for loading reports
description: A valid input can contain a date whose currencies are all N/A. The report counts dates with at least one stored rate, matching the explicit reporting rule.

options.label: Count dates with at least one stored rate

title: Conversion result precision
description: The conversion rate is rounded for presentation, while the result is computed from the exact stored rates before rounding.

options.label: Calculate the result from the displayed rounded rate
Calculate the result from the exact source rates

title: Empty history statistics
description: A valid currency and range can produce no points. Return count zero, null summary values, and an empty points array.

options.label: Omit statistics when no points exist
Return null statistics and no points

title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes rates(date); rates(currency, date). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.
